idea-plugin.name: Demystified Stack Trace Links
idea-plugin.description:
Makes file:line fragments inside Ben.Demystifier-formatted (Serilog WithDemystifiedStackTraces) exception frames clickable in Rider's Run/Debug/Terminal console, even when the surrounding method signature does not match the built-in Stack Trace Explorer grammar.

Also watches the clipboard and automatically opens Rider's Stacktrace window (Tools | Analyze Stack Trace or Thread Dump) as soon as something that looks like an exception stack trace is copied -- Rider does not do this on its own.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0

  • New: automatically opens the Stacktrace window when a stack trace is detected on the clipboard, mirroring the manual Tools | Analyze Stack Trace or Thread Dump action.
  • Plugin now stays compatible with future Rider versions (no explicit untilBuild upper bound).

1.0.0

  • Initial release: recognizes .cs/.vb/.fs "in file:line N" fragments inside demystified stack traces printed to Run/Debug/Terminal consoles.
